how_to: فایل را به مترجم بده؛ خروجی را با نام fa-out-quest-western-plaguelands-01.json برگردان.
rules: به فارسی روان و معنادار ترجمه کن، نه آوانگاری؛ فقط نام خاص شخص/مکان آوانگاری می‌شود. هر ⟦...⟧ را دقیقاً همان‌طور و به تعداد اصلی نگه دار (جابه‌جایی در جمله مجاز است). عددها را حفظ کن (ارقام فارسی یا لاتین فرقی ندارد). ی و ک فارسی، نیم‌فاصله در «می‌»، «ها» و «ای». هیچ حرف لاتین در خروجی نباشد مگر داخل ⟦...⟧. از glossary برای واژه‌ها پیروی کن. خروجی فقط JSON: {"pack": <همین pack>, "fa": {"<کلید>": "ترجمه"}} با همهٔ کلیدهای rows، نه کم نه زیاد.
tokens_note: ⟦عدد⟧ = کد بازی (نام بازیکن، خط جدید، رنگ). ⟦E..⟧ = نام مصوب؛ معنی‌اش در entities است. هر دو را دست‌نخورده نگه دار.

rows.quest:105:obj:0: Bring Araj's Phylactery Shard to High Executor Derrington at the Bulwark, ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:105:details:0: Alas, the time to attack Andorhal and drive out the lich that controls it is upon us!
rows.quest:105:details:1: BInside the ruins of the city is where the lich - Araj the Summoner - holds dominion. He is guarded by numerous Scourge surrounding the remains of city's center, and his personal retinue of guardians attached to him directly is formidable. You will need numerous allies to even stand a chance of facing him successfully.
rows.quest:105:details:2: BDestroy Araj, ⟦1⟧, and bring me a shard from his phylactery as proof!
rows.quest:105:completion:0: You've done it! Araj... the lich is finally defeated!
rows.quest:105:completion:1: BYou've done a tremendous service to the ⟦E2⟧ on this day, ⟦2⟧. Your bravery and perseverance are a testament to what it means to be a true hero. Please - accept this as a token for all to see and know that you have delivered the ⟦E2⟧ a victory for the ages!

rows.quest:838:obj:0: Speak with Apothecary Dithers at the Bulwark, ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:838:details:0: On the island of ⟦E4⟧ lies Scholomance - a school that serves as a stronghold for the Scourge. Our enemy dwells within, safely allowed to pursue research that strengthens their power. A door bars the way, and try as we might no entry is to be had without a proper key.
rows.quest:838:details:1: BApothecary Dithers is well versed on Scholomance, and has an idea how to obtain a key. You have proved your value to me as someone who can get things done; I now entrust this task to you. Speak with him on this matter.
rows.quest:838:completion:0: Yes, ⟦5⟧, the High Executor mentioned you might be the one to trust in the matter of the key. I've dedicated a fair portion of my recent studies to the Scholomance, and I believe I know a means by which you can acquire one that will let you past the front door at will.⟦6⟧⟦7⟧This task will not be easy, but such tasks seldom are. You most assuredly look like the type to know this as fact.
rows.quest:964:obj:0: Bring 15 Skeletal Fragments to Apothecary Dithers at the Bulwark, ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:964:details:0: The key to Scholomance is called a Skeleton Key. It must be forged from the remains of a skeleton - several actually - and hardened by only the strongest of metals within a suitable mold. A signet of power from a being who naturally can open the portal to Scholomance will make the key ultimately function.
rows.quest:964:details:1: BFirst thing's first though, ⟦8⟧. We'll need skeletal fragments for the key's forging. Skeletons inside Andorhal should yield what we need, but the ones outside the walls might work too.
rows.quest:964:completion:0: This'll work, ⟦9⟧! My turn now - I will imbue these with a suitable temper that will allow them to survive the intense forging process they will eventually go through.
rows.quest:964:completion:1: BThe next step will be to get an appropriate mold for the key. I know a goblin blacksmith in ⟦E5⟧ that has in the past made molds for similarly macabre items. He works for whom goblins usually work for - the highest bidder.
rows.quest:4971:obj:0: Use the Temporal Displacer near one of Andorhal's silos and uncover Temporal Parasites.
rows.quest:4971:obj:1: BSlay 10 Temporal Parasites, and then return the Temporal Displacer to Chromie in the Andorhal Inn, ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:4971:details:0: Tampering of the timeline by a sinister force - most likely the Scourge - has occurred in Andorhal! I can try to keep the passage of time here intact and mend what has been damaged, but I'll need your help to do so uninterrupted.
rows.quest:4971:details:1: BTemporal parasites - carrion that feed on the strands of time's altered flow - now infest the silos of Andorhal. A blue pulse of distortion is their only visual marker. They slow my auguries; please ⟦10⟧, help me by using this temporal displacer to root out these parasites.
rows.quest:4971:completion:0: Time feels easier to mend now, thank you ⟦11⟧. While you might not understand fully the consequences of a fractured timeline, I appreciate that you understand the urgency of countering what I suspect more and more to be a Scourge-driven malfeasance.
rows.quest:4971:completion:1: BI see no harm in rewarding you for your assistance, mortal. Your greatest feats are to come, and the awarding of a bauble will certainly not alter your future destiny. Your continued aid, however, is something that I and the dragonflight could use...
rows.quest:4972:obj:0: Locate 5 Andorhal Watches, found in lockboxes amongst the rubble of the city. Return with them to Chromie in the Andorhal Inn, ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:4972:details:0: I need you to reach into the world beyond this room, ⟦12⟧. Allow me to explain.
rows.quest:4972:details:1: BYou see the difference in this room compared to the rest of Andorhal. My dragonflight works in many different ways and in many different timelines. To mend Andorhal's damage, I now act from a different timeline as not to overly contaminate it. To continue this though I need time trinkets, ones trapped from when the plague hit. Find them in lockboxes found in the ruined buildings that make up this once proud city.
rows.quest:4972:completion:0: These are exactly what I need, ⟦13⟧. Thank you.
rows.quest:4972:completion:1: BAllow me to suitably reward you with this. You may not understand what you would need with such a device. You might not even know quite what it really is. Alas, I cannot tell you when you will find it most useful; just know that at some point in the future, you may find this item to have extreme utility and function when consumed. Whether or not you choose to hold on to it until then... this, my friend, is up to you.
rows.quest:4984:obj:0: Destroy 8 Diseased Wolves, and then return to Mulgris Deepriver at the Writhing Haunt, ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:4984:details:0: While there was little I could do alone to thwart the Scourge, I nevertheless came to these lands to try and heal the damage done to nature. Animals suffer from the plague that continues to choke these lands, unable to find mercy and peace. I ask for you to continue what I could not finish here.
rows.quest:4984:details:1: BThere is no ⟦E6⟧ for the suffering animals but a sweet and merciful release. Seek out diseased wolves nearby and put them down. Please ⟦14⟧, end their misery - doing so will surely soothe mine.
rows.quest:4984:completion:0: I... I sense that the souls of those wolves you have put down now have rest. They - and I - thank you for a merciful release.
rows.quest:4984:completion:1: BThe wolves are not alone in their suffering within this damnable place, ⟦15⟧. Please, I have need of you once more.
rows.quest:4985:obj:0: Destroy 8 Diseased Grizzlies, and then return to Mulgris Deepriver at the Writhing Haunt, ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:4985:details:0: To the east of where we are, near where the ⟦E7⟧ begin, once proud and majestic grizzlies roamed the countryside. The plague released by the Scourge has sundered these beasts too. They wander the countryside, agonized by the stiffening of their muscles and the rotting of their fur and flesh.
rows.quest:4985:details:1: BI ask of you to end their misery as well. The only cure for their suffering is a swift death, one that must be ministered by your hand.
rows.quest:4985:completion:0: "I know that the grizzles have been put down, their torment at an end. I... I have one more thing for you. I wrote it down on... on this branch, sensing that my time in this realm had come to an end.
rows.quest:4985:completion:1: BIndeed... I am at that end. Thank you again friend... the creatures of this accursed land may rest... and now shall I."
rows.quest:4985:completion:2: BWith that, a heavy sigh is uttered by the druid, followed by what sounds like a death rattle. His body lies motionless on the cottage floor.
rows.quest:4986:obj:0: Based on the magic enchanted within the Glyphed Oaken Branch, its delivery to the Cenarion Circle in ⟦E8⟧ is the next step the tauren druid sought. Seek one of the druids there for assistance.
rows.quest:4986:details:0: The lifeless hand of the tauren druid clutches a surprisingly healthy looking oaken branch. Examining the branch reveals glyphs of a druidic nature carved into the bark.
rows.quest:4986:details:1: BAs you grasp the branch, you notice it is warm to the touch, more than it should be. The image of the ⟦E9⟧ tree enters your mind - ⟦E8⟧ specifically - and the words "Cenarion Circle" are on the tip of your tongue. It would appear that the suggestion of where to take the branch has been placed within it.
rows.quest:4986:completion:0: This... this is quite strange. This druid - this tauren druid no less - entrusted you with a great deal of valuable information on the extent of the Scourge's plague. I am surprised a tauren would give a ⟦16⟧ such information, and freely at that if what you say is true. We will make good use of this, I promise you. Perhaps the tauren have not fallen as far from Cenarius as Fandral would believe...
rows.quest:4986:completion:1: BErm, anyway, please - accept this as a token of thanks from the Cenarion Circle.
rows.quest:4987:obj:0: Based on the magic enchanted within the Glyphed Oaken Branch, its delivery to the Cenarion Circle in ⟦E10⟧ is the next step the tauren druid sought. Seek one of the druids there for assistance.
rows.quest:4987:details:0: The lifeless hand of the tauren druid clutches a surprisingly healthy looking oaken branch. Examining the branch reveals glyphs of a druidic nature carved into the bark.
rows.quest:4987:details:1: BAs you grasp the branch, you notice it is warm to the touch, more than it should be. The image of ⟦E10⟧ in ⟦E11⟧ enters your mind - Elder Rise specifically - and the words "Cenarion Circle" are on the tip of your tongue. It would appear that the suggestion of where to take the branch has been placed within it.
rows.quest:4987:completion:0: This is from Mulgris, you say? We had heard he sought to minister to the creatures suffering in the ⟦E12⟧, but this is most unexpected... and most saddening. Mulgris is... was a good friend. I will mourn his passing deeply.
rows.quest:4987:completion:1: BHis efforts have not gone in vain, thanks to your diligence. In this branch, much lore is stored about the plague the Scourge propagates upon the land. We will study it diligently. As for you, please accept this. It is the least we can do for your noble efforts.
rows.quest:5021:obj:0: The ramblings of the ghostly woman indicated that she needed a package delivered. She claimed that it was where her horse was. As to where the horse is or where the package was to be delivered - the ghost remains incomprehensible.
rows.quest:5021:details:0: "The package must be delivered... delivered before I'm trapped here!"
rows.quest:5021:details:1: BThe cries of a panicked woman feel almost like a whisper floating through the house. Cowered in the upstairs corner is the apparition of a woman. She does not seem to be fully cognizant of her surroundings, and she is only vaguely aware of you.
rows.quest:5021:details:2: B"Are you here to deliver my package? Please, before it gets much worse! I was going to ride out of here. It should still be by my horse... or am I too late?"
rows.quest:5021:completion:0: A package in the barn that you might have otherwise overlooked now stands out amongst the decay and ruin. Perhaps this is the one that the ghost of Janice Felstone was clamoring about...
rows.quest:5022:obj:0: Check with the Royal Factors of ⟦E13⟧ to learn the whereabouts of an Emma Felstone. There is usually a census officer located in City Hall.
rows.quest:5022:details:0: You pick up the package, wiping off a small layer of dust and grime that had settled on it. It is addressed in a hurried hand to an Emma Felstone of ⟦E13⟧; the delivery of the package is dated for well over four years ago.
rows.quest:5022:details:1: BThough it is unclear if Emma Felstone is even alive, it is widely known that the ⟦E14⟧ Hall keep records on the populace of the city. This is handled through the Royal Factors of the ⟦E13⟧ Census.
rows.quest:5022:completion:0: A package for an Emma Felstone, you say? Last known address was ⟦E13⟧, four years ago? Well let me see here...
rows.quest:5022:completion:1: BAccording to what we know, there was an Emma Felstone in the city about four years ago. Well, I should say possibly - this census I refer to is from five years ago, and I don't have a report of her vacating the city. This doesn't mean that she is still here though.
rows.quest:5022:completion:2: BWait a second... this package couldn't be for Ol' Emma, could it?
rows.quest:5023:obj:0: Check with the Royal Overseers of the ⟦E15⟧ to learn the whereabouts of a Jeremiah Felstone. There is usually a census officer located near guild and tabard registration.
rows.quest:5023:details:0: You pick up the package, wiping off a small layer of dust and grime that had settled on it. It is addressed in a hurried hand to a Jeremiah Felstone of Lordaeron; the delivery of the package is dated for well over four years ago.
rows.quest:5023:details:1: BThough it is unclear if Jeremiah Felstone is even alive, it is widely known that the ⟦E15⟧, formerly known as Lordaeron, keeps records on the populace of the city. This is handled through the Royal Overseers of the ⟦E15⟧ Census.
rows.quest:5023:completion:0: A package for a Jeremiah Felstone, with his last known address as Lordaeron... I should be able to assist you.
rows.quest:5023:completion:1: BJeremiah Felstone was in the city before the plague. Well, I should say the former Jeremiah Felstone - some of the ⟦E16⟧ have changed their last names to rid themselves of their former countenance. This case is no exception; the former Jeremiah Felstone is now known as Jeremiah Payson.
rows.quest:5023:completion:2: BWait a minute... isn't he the cockroach vendor?
rows.quest:5050:obj:0: Return to Janice Felstone in ⟦E1⟧ her Good Luck Half-Charm.
rows.quest:5050:details:0: It would seem that I was wrong about you ⟦17⟧, and for that I owe you an apology. My sister sent me a number of personal effects, including humorously enough the deed to the Felstone farm. I think I'll pass on reclaiming it right now.
rows.quest:5050:details:1: BIf my sister's spirit remains tethered to the farm and cannot rest, please... could you return this to her? It is half of a good luck charm she had, with her husband having the other half.
rows.quest:5050:details:2: BMaybe her knowing I have these things will now put her soul to rest.
rows.quest:5050:completion:0: You give the half-charm back to the apparition. She looks at it, then at you expectantly.
rows.quest:5050:completion:1: B"Honey, where did you put your half of the charm? We can't be together unless we have both halves. Honey... can you see me?"
rows.quest:5051:obj:0: Locate the other half of the Good Luck Charm somewhere on the Felstone Farm in ⟦E1⟧ and reassemble it.
rows.quest:5051:obj:1: BGive the Good Luck Charm to Janice Felstone on the Felstone Farm, ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:5051:details:0: The ramblings of the poor ghost continue:
rows.quest:5051:details:1: B"I'm so cold, John. Bring me your charm, and we'll be together! Quickly John, before the plague comes to change us into hideous beasts! I can't see you John... but I know you're near. I feel you near me."
rows.quest:5051:details:2: BPerhaps if the second half of the charm was found and reassembled, this would constitute what the spirit of Janice Felstone is seeking.
rows.quest:5051:completion:0: You hand the reassembled good luck charm to Janice Felstone's ghost. As soon as she grasps it, you observe an almost immediate change in her. Her ethereal form shimmers, and she looks upon you with clear yet sad eyes.
rows.quest:5051:completion:1: B"You've freed me... I no longer will need this charm. Please, take it and perhaps it will give you the solace it has given me."
rows.quest:5058:completion:0: A diary with yellowing pages lies open to the last entry:
rows.quest:5058:completion:1: B"I don't know what's going to happen now that Harold's turned. It took everything out of me to drag him into the only place I could find that'd lock him up tight and hold him. I hid the key on me, and I pray it works...
rows.quest:5058:completion:2: BI hope I can get out of here, but I need money to do that. Our stuff's all in the cabinet I think... and now that I think about it, doesn't Harold keep the key on him?
rows.quest:5058:completion:3: BI'll rest on it, I'm dead tired now."
rows.quest:5060:completion:0: The key taken from Farmer Dalson's ghoulish remains fits the lock perfectly. The doors of the cabinet swing open, revealing several items that remain intact and appear quite valuable.
rows.quest:5092:obj:0: Kill 10 Skeletal Flayers and 10 Slavering Ghouls in Sorrow Hill.
rows.quest:5092:obj:1: BReturn to Commander Ashlam Valorfist at Chillwind Camp, ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:5092:details:0: With Andorhal's western and northern roads into the city well fortified, I'm looking to strike at it from the less defended eastern road. The Scourge relies on the buffer of undead that infests Sorrow Hill as a first line of defense. If we are to advance on Andorhal, we will need to do it through Sorrow Hill.
rows.quest:5092:details:1: BYour first assignment will be to clear the way through Sorrow Hill. Thin out the skeletons and ghouls that haunt the area; report back to me when this is done!
rows.quest:5092:completion:0: Mission accomplished, ⟦18⟧! Well played, well played.
rows.quest:5092:completion:1: BAllow me to reward your work thus far with some coin from the ⟦E13⟧ coffers. I'd recommend spending it on materiel that will aid you in your next mission... one that will take you into the ruins of Andorhal itself.
rows.quest:5093:obj:0: Seek out High Executor Derrington. His base camp is located at the Bulwark, east of Tirisfal Glade and the ⟦E15⟧.
rows.quest:5093:details:0: Heroes of the realm, hear me - the ⟦E2⟧ calls upon you for swift action!
rows.quest:5093:details:1: BA call to arms has been issued for all able bodied individuals to take up arms against the Scourge! Rumors fly of new threats rising from the ruins of the ⟦E17⟧. They loom to the east of the ⟦E15⟧, in the northern reaches of the lands now known as the ⟦E12⟧!
rows.quest:5093:details:2: BHeroes of the realm - seek out High Executor Derrington, who has set up his base camp at the Bulwark, east of Tirisfal Glade!
rows.quest:5093:completion:0: Welcome to the ⟦E12⟧, hero. This is one of the most dangerous frontiers in ⟦E18⟧, with the looming threat of the Scourge to our east, and then even further still eastward from there. I am glad to hear that the call of duty and service to the ⟦E2⟧ did not fall on deaf ears with you!
rows.quest:5093:completion:1: BIf you are ready to get your hands dirty, then there is plenty for willing and able heroes to do here on the edge of the ⟦E12⟧.

rows.quest:5096:obj:0: Proceed to the ⟦E20⟧'s base camp between Felstone Field and Dalson's Tears and destroy their command tent.
rows.quest:5096:obj:1: BPlace the Scourge banner at the camp, and then return to High Executor Derrington at the Bulwark, ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:5096:details:0: Before Andorhal, we must tackle the advancing ⟦E20⟧ menace from Hearthglen. They've made camp between Felstone Field and Dalson's Tears, making us risk conflict against both the Scourge and the Crusade at once.
rows.quest:5096:details:1: BMy plan is to play them off of each other by sending you to destroy the command tent they've set up; use some Flame in a Bottle from this box of incendiaries. Once razed, plant this Scourge banner by the tent. With some luck, they'll ignore us and focus on the Scourge for vengeance.
rows.quest:5096:completion:0: Finely executed, ⟦19⟧. Your attack on the ⟦E20⟧ will buy us time. I have sent one of my best scouts out to watch over the camp and make sure that the Crusade forces that come to reinforce the position will take the bait.
rows.quest:5096:completion:1: BWith the pressure on us lessened, we should now finally be able to risk a mission into Andorhal itself, and an important one at that. I'd very much like it if you'd perform this one as well, based on your success to date.
rows.quest:5097:obj:0: Using the Beacon Torch, mark each tower in Andorhal; you will need to stand in the doorway of the tower to successfully mark it.
rows.quest:5097:obj:1: BOnce all four towers are marked, return the Beacon Torch to Commander Ashlam Valorfist in Chillwind Camp, ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:5097:details:0: Through the use of a magical device known as a beacon torch, we can mark targets of our choosing for future actions by our troops. To that end, we think the Scourge are using Andorhal's watchtowers as a means to control their troop movements.
rows.quest:5097:details:1: BYour mission: breach Andorhal's defenses to plant beacons at all four watchtowers. You'll need to be in the doorway of each tower to plant the beacon; it will then proceed to mark the tower. There are only five charges on the beacon torch, so use them wisely!
rows.quest:5097:completion:0: My priests are reporting that our beacon trackers are picking up extremely strong signals on all four towers! Dare I say it, but I believe you've executed another mission with complete and total success! Well played once again, ⟦20⟧!
rows.quest:5097:completion:1: BWith the towers marked, our preparations for the attack are now in place. The time has come to take the fight to the Scourge!

rows.quest:5098:details:1: BYour mission: breach Andorhal's defenses to plant beacons at all four watchtowers. You'll need to be in the doorway of each tower to plant the beacon; it will then proceed to mark the tower. There are only five charges on the beacon torch, so use them wisely!
rows.quest:5098:completion:0: My priests are reporting that our beacon trackers are picking up extremely strong signals on all four towers! Dare I say it, but I believe you've executed another mission with complete and total success! Well played once again, ⟦21⟧!
rows.quest:5098:completion:1: BWith the towers marked, our preparations for the attack are now in place. The time has come to take the fight to the Scourge!
rows.quest:5154:obj:0: Bring the Annals of Darrowshire to Chromie in Andorhal.
rows.quest:5154:details:0: To save ⟦E21⟧ Redpath, we must first discover his past. We can learn this in the Annals of Darrowshire, a book held in the city hall of Andorhal.
rows.quest:5154:details:1: BBring me that book. We can then learn ⟦E21⟧'s fate, and with luck... change it!
rows.quest:5154:completion:1: BDid you read it? Is ⟦E21⟧ Redpath mentioned? If he is, then perhaps we can save him!
rows.quest:5154:completion:2: BAh. The Annals of Darrowshire tell a very unsettling tale. It says that during the battle, ⟦E21⟧ Redpath was corrupted and joined the ranks of the Scourge! He then betrayed the defenders of Darrowshire.
rows.quest:5154:completion:3: BThat is an ill fate. If we can, we should try to change that fate, don't you think?
rows.quest:5162:obj:0: Speak with Jeziba in the ⟦E12⟧. He resides in Andorhal.
rows.quest:5162:details:0: It is the arcane that I control and the arcane which will send you to your next destination.
rows.quest:5162:details:1: BWhen you are ready, the journey will begin. To the ⟦E12⟧ you will go and to Jeziba you will speak.
rows.quest:5162:details:2: BHe is a mortal as wise as the ancients and as patient as the immovable earth. Find him in Andorhal.⟦22⟧
rows.quest:5162:completion:0: I am Jeziba, known to many as the Sculptor. What I sculpt, however, are not statues, but heroes.
rows.quest:5164:obj:0: Read from the Catalogue of the Wayward.⟦23⟧
rows.quest:5164:details:0: A finer instrument of justice, Haleh could not have chosen. Read from the catalogue of the wayward and be enlightened.
rows.quest:5164:details:1: BShould you persist... should you do what is asked of you... should you survive... a hero you will make.
rows.quest:5164:completion:0: Hundreds upon hundreds of pages filled with garbled text and symbols make up the brunt of this book.
rows.quest:5166:obj:0: To forge the Breastplate of the Chromatic Flight, you will be required to bring the following items to Jeziba the 'Sculptor':
rows.quest:5166:details:0: The forging of a powerful breastplate to protect against the unrelenting attacks of the chromatic flight is one built upon irony.
rows.quest:5166:details:1: BThe scales of the very beasts we battle must be sewn to the pristine carapace of an elder chromatic drake or dragon. None are known to exist at this time and we should hope that none will ever exist.
rows.quest:5166:details:2: BLastly, perhaps the most difficult of all components: the blood of heroes.
rows.quest:5166:details:3: BThe Sculptor must ultimately forge this creation.
rows.quest:5166:completion:0: Do you not yet understand? The journey was the destination. Can you not feel the battle scars? The pain you underwent?
rows.quest:5166:completion:1: BHaving survived the ordeal, you are a more powerful being. Much more powerful. This breastplate is merely a reflection of your own innate abilities.
rows.quest:5167:obj:0: To forge the Legplates of the Chromatic Defier, you will be required to bring the following items to Jeziba the 'Sculptor':
rows.quest:5167:details:0: The carapace of a mature chromatic drake is needed to form the foundation of the leggings. Brilliant chromatic scales are then layered upon the wire frame and enchanted in the blood of heroes. Finally, the supple skin of shadow must be applied to the inner greaves.
rows.quest:5167:completion:0: They will smell their kin as you enter their halls, ⟦24⟧. Crush them with their own fear!
rows.quest:5215:obj:0: Speak with High Priestess MacDonnell at Chillwind Point, ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:5215:details:0: Within the lands of former Lordaeron are eight cauldrons - four here in the west, and four more ensconced in the east. These cauldrons spew poisons into the air, propagating the plague throughout the land for the Scourge.
rows.quest:5215:details:1: BThe necromantic might of Kel'Thuzad is too strong to outright shut down these cauldrons, but we think we might have a way to subvert them to our advantage. My second, High Priestess MacDonnell, will be your point on this assignment; she'll continue the briefing from here.
rows.quest:5215:completion:0: May the power of the Light shine upon you in these dark times, ⟦25⟧. I am pleased to serve as your coordinator for our plan to sabotage the Scourge's cauldrons.
rows.quest:5215:completion:1: BOur goal will be to change the composition of the plague that the cauldrons create into something that negatively affects the Scourge. In order to affect this change, you will need to secure access to each of the four cauldrons present in the ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:5215:completion:2: BStand ready hero, for a glorious battle against the vile Scourge awaits you!
rows.quest:5216:obj:0: Go to Felstone Field in ⟦E1⟧ to locate and defeat the Cauldron Lord present there. It may have a key that will allow access to the cauldron. You must have the Empty Felstone Field Bottle with you to secure a sample of the poisons used inside the cauldron.
rows.quest:5216:details:0: Of the four cauldrons here in the west, the one located at Felstone Field may be the easiest one in obtaining access to. The Scourge have greener troops positioned here, though they should not be underestimated.
rows.quest:5216:details:1: BGo to Felstone Field, northwest of Andorhal, and engage the cauldron lord there. We think it has a key that will unlock access to the cauldron. When unlocked, use this bottle to obtain a sample of the poisons inside the cauldron; we'll need it for study in developing a counter agent.
rows.quest:5216:completion:0: The key taken from Cauldron Lord Bilemaw is a perfect fit in unlocking the access panel. A foul stench emanates from the opened panel as an unknown mix of concentrated substances swirl inside the cauldron.
rows.quest:5216:completion:1: BThere is a small spigot that the bottle fits well enough under, allowing you to draw a sample for High Priestess MacDonnell back at Chillwind Point.
rows.quest:5217:obj:0: Bring the Filled Felstone Field Bottle to High Priestess MacDonnell at Chillwind Camp, ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:5217:details:0: You fill the bottle with enough of the cauldron's poisonous concoction for a suitable sample to be studied.
rows.quest:5217:details:1: BWith the poison in hand, it is time to return to High Priestess MacDonnell at Chillwind Camp to complete the mission.
rows.quest:5217:completion:0: Well done ⟦26⟧ - it should take Alchemist Arbington no time at all to analyze this and devise a counter agent to introduce into the cauldron. If we are able to pump out enough of it into the air, we might be able to weaken all the Scourge present here.
rows.quest:5217:completion:1: BThis will no doubt be an ongoing ordeal; we will need to continually hit these cauldrons and introduce our reagents into their mix. Still, if we can keep it up, we will have a huge advantage over Scourge when the time comes for battle!
rows.quest:5219:obj:0: Go to Dalson's Tears in ⟦E1⟧ to locate and defeat the Cauldron Lord present there, and use its key to gain access to the cauldron. You must have the Empty Dalson's Tears Bottle with you to secure a sample of the poisons used inside the cauldron.
rows.quest:5219:details:0: One of the plague cauldrons is located in the field of a former farmhouse now referred to as Dalson's Tears. Well, we shall shed no tears this day as we thwart the Scourge and have them choke on their own fumes!
rows.quest:5219:details:1: BGo to Dalson's Tears, almost due north of Andorhal, and eliminate the cauldron lord there. It should have a key like the last one did, allowing you into the cauldron. Use this bottle to obtain a sample from inside the cauldron; each cauldron has its own distinct brew of toxins it uses.
rows.quest:5219:completion:0: The macabre key found on the cauldron lord easily slides into a keyhole and then disappears, allowing you permanent access to it. Crude, viscous ichors pulsate through twisted tubes within the cauldrons underpinnings.
rows.quest:5219:completion:1: BThere is a small spigot that the bottle fits well enough under, allowing you to draw a sample for High Priestess MacDonnell back at Chillwind Point.
rows.quest:5220:obj:0: Bring the Filled Dalson's Tears Bottle to High Priestess MacDonnell at Chillwind Camp, ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:5220:details:0: You carefully fill the bottle with enough of the cauldron's ichors for what you consider to be suitably sized sample.
rows.quest:5220:details:1: BWith the poison in hand, it is time to return to High Priestess MacDonnell at Chillwind Camp to complete the mission.
rows.quest:5220:completion:0: Ah, there is plenty in here for study. Well done, ⟦27⟧!
rows.quest:5220:completion:1: BFor now, the next step is in our hands. We'll need to produce a list of reagents that, when combined with what is already in the cauldron, will act as its counter.
rows.quest:5220:completion:2: BThe only way we will be able to introduce this is by placing the reagents into the cauldron directly. Alchemist Arbington will have more information on that, so be sure to speak with him at your earliest convenience.
rows.quest:5222:obj:0: Go to the Writhing Haunt in ⟦E1⟧ to locate and defeat the Cauldron Lord present there, and use its key to gain access to the cauldron. You must have the Empty Writhing Haunt Bottle with you to secure a sample of the poisons used inside the cauldron.
rows.quest:5222:details:0: Two cauldrons have been successfully opened; while you will be able to access them indefinitely, we still want to open up the other two that remain. This will provide all of us with more options to introduce the counter agent!
rows.quest:5222:details:1: BThis time, you'll be hitting the Writhing Haunt's cauldron. It is almost due east of Andorhal, relatively close to the ruined city walls; again, eliminate the cauldron lord present there for its key. Use this bottle to obtain the sample from the cauldron.
rows.quest:5222:completion:0: The cauldron lord's key unlocks the access panel to this cauldron and then disappears, much like the other keys have for the previous two cauldrons you've dealt of. A putrid smelling substance churns violently beneath the platform of the cauldron.
rows.quest:5222:completion:1: BThere is a small spigot that the bottle fits well enough under, allowing you to draw a sample for High Priestess MacDonnell back at Chillwind Point.
rows.quest:5223:obj:0: Bring the Filled Writhing Haunt Bottle to High Priestess MacDonnell at Chillwind Camp, ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:5223:details:0: You delicately top off the empty bottle; a sample of the foul substance that churns under the platform of the cauldron now oozes back and forth inside the fragile glass container.
rows.quest:5223:details:1: BWith the poison in hand, it is time to return to High Priestess MacDonnell at Chillwind Camp to complete the mission.
rows.quest:5223:completion:0: Another finely executed mission, ⟦29⟧! This makes three cauldrons available to us to turn against the Scourge. If Kel'Thuzad's necromantic dominance over these lands wasn't as strong as it currently is, I'd dare say you'd shut them down completely!
rows.quest:5223:completion:1: BAlchemist Arbington will have a report on what this cauldron - as well as the other cauldrons subverted - will require to deliver our counter agent to the plague. With that, the time has come to bring the last cauldron of the west under our influence!
rows.quest:5225:obj:0: Go to Gahrron's Withering in ⟦E1⟧ to locate and defeat the Cauldron Lord present there, and use its key to gain access to the cauldron. You must have the Empty Gahrron's Withering Bottle with you to secure a sample of the poisons used inside the cauldron.
rows.quest:5225:details:0: The last cauldron that remains is located on a farm now called Gahrron's Withering. It is guarded by some of the Scourge's tougher minions - specifically, wraiths and ghosts. They are not to be trifled with, ⟦30⟧.
rows.quest:5225:details:1: BGahrron's Withering is due northeast of our position here, close to where the ⟦E7⟧ begin; again, eliminate the cauldron lord present there for its key. Here is your empty sample bottle; bring it to me filled. May the Light protect you in this dangerous mission, ⟦31⟧.
rows.quest:5225:completion:0: Cauldron Lord Soulwrath's key disintegrates as it touches the lock on the access panel at the base of the cauldron's platform. A slight clanking noise is heard within, and the access panel swings open to reveal more viscous toxins within the cauldron's framework.
rows.quest:5225:completion:1: BThere is a small spigot that the bottle fits well enough under, allowing you to draw a sample for High Priestess MacDonnell back at Chillwind Point.
rows.quest:5226:obj:0: Bring the Filled Gahrron's Withering Bottle to High Priestess MacDonnell at Chillwind Camp, ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:5226:details:0: You carefully close the spigot in the control panel, watching the cauldron's putrid ichors drip into the empty bottle.
rows.quest:5226:details:1: BWith the poison in hand, it is time to return to High Priestess MacDonnell at Chillwind Camp to complete the mission.
rows.quest:5226:completion:0: Congratulations ⟦32⟧, you've unlocked the last cauldron for us! Alchemist Arbington will soon know what this cauldron requires as far as reagents needed for the mix.
rows.quest:5226:completion:1: BAs for you, I am sure that Commander Valorfist will want to thank you personally for the assistance you've given us. Without you, our struggle against the Scourge would have been nearly insurmountable. Thank you, hero!
rows.quest:5228:obj:0: Speak with Shadow Priestess Vandis at the Bulwark, ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:5228:details:0: Within the lands of former Lordaeron are eight cauldrons - four in the west, and four more entrenched in the east. These cauldrons spew poisons into the air, propagating the plague throughout the land for the Scourge.
rows.quest:5228:details:1: BThe necromantic might of Kel'Thuzad is too strong to outright shut down these cauldrons, but we think we might have a way to subvert them to our advantage. My second, Shadow Priestess Vandis, will be your point on this assignment; she'll continue the briefing from here.
rows.quest:5228:completion:0: From the shadows, brother ⟦33⟧, I bid you greetings. I am to serve as your coordinator for our plan to sabotage the Scourge's cauldrons.
rows.quest:5228:completion:1: BOur goal will be to change the composition of the plague that the cauldrons create into something that negatively affects the Scourge. In order to affect this change, you will need to secure access to each of the four cauldrons here in the ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:5228:completion:2: BThe time has come for you to lead the charge against the Scourge, hero.
rows.quest:5229:obj:0: Go to Felstone Field in ⟦E1⟧ to locate and defeat the Cauldron Lord present there. It may have a key that will allow access to the cauldron. You must have the Empty Felstone Field Bottle with you to secure a sample of the poisons used inside the cauldron.
rows.quest:5229:details:0: Of the four cauldrons in the ⟦E1⟧, the one at Felstone Field may be the easiest one to gain access to. The Scourge have greener troops positioned here, though they should not be underestimated.
rows.quest:5229:details:1: BGo to Felstone Field, due east of here and northwest of Andorhal, and engage the cauldron lord there. On it is a key that will unlock access to the cauldron. When unlocked, use this bottle to get a sample of the cauldron's toxins; we'll need it for study in developing a counter agent.
rows.quest:5229:completion:0: The key taken from Cauldron Lord Bilemaw is a perfect fit in unlocking the access panel, though it disappears after you use it. Still, you think you can open the panel now without a key. A foul stench emanates from the opened panel as an unknown mix of concentrated substances swirl inside the cauldron.
rows.quest:5229:completion:1: BThere is a small spigot that the bottle fits well enough under, allowing you to draw a sample for Shadow Priestess Vandis back at the Bulwark.
